name: @pipeworx/mcp-bonanza

tools.name: bonanza_search
tools.description: Search active Bonanza marketplace listings by keyword (Bonapitit findItemsByKeywords). Requires a Bonanza API devID. No sold data — orders are seller-scoped on this API.

tools.name: bonanza_search_by_category
tools.description: Search active Bonanza marketplace listings within a category ID (Bonapitit findItemsByCategory). Requires a Bonanza API devID.

tools.name: bonanza_get_item
tools.description: Get a single Bonanza listing by item ID (Bonapitit getSingleItem). Requires a Bonanza API devID.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bonanza forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bonanza pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
